'''Finley''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] and the leader of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Fifth Expeditionary Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]], Finley participated in the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] as he aided the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] and [[Warren Sedoru]] in the [[Mission to Balmorra (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|search]] for a [[prototype cloaking device]].
